metadata.question: Did the Cuyuni River (6.437929, -58.628264) appear lighter in color than the Mazaruni and Essequibo Rivers near their confluence (6.407305, -58.606792) on August 16, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) on 2023-08-16 for the area covering two ROIs:
     • Cuyuni River: (6.437929, -58.628264)
     • Mazaruni+Essequibo near confluence: (6.407305, -58.606792)
   - If no S2 images, fall back to Landsat 9 L2, then Landsat 8 L2 (same date). If still empty, widen window by ±1 day and retry (S2 → L9 → L8). If all fail, output C1.
2. Masking strategy.
   - Mask clouds (S2: QA60 bits 10/11; Landsat: QA_PIXEL bits for cloud/shadow/cirrus/snow).
   - Derive water using mNDWI > 0 on the same image and restrict stats to water pixels.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
   - Compute pixel counts of valid water pixels in each ROI; if either is 0, output C2.
   - Compute visible mean reflectance (mean of blue, green, red). If result is null/NaN or outside [0,1], output C3.
   - If Cuyuni reflectance > confluence reflectance by ≥0.01, answer A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const cuyuniPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.628264, 6.437929]);
    const conflPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.606792, 6.407305]);
    const roiBufM = 2000; // larger buffer to ensure pixels at 1000 m scale
    const cuyuni = cuyuniPt.buffer(roiBufM);
    const confl = conflPt.buffer(roiBufM);
    const aoi = cuyuni.union(confl);

    const dayStart = '2023-08-16';
    const dayEnd = '2023-08-17';
    const widenStart = '2023-08-15';
    const widenEnd = '2023-08-18';

    // 2. Helper functions
    function prepS2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
      const scaled = img.select(['B2','B3','B4','B11']).multiply(0.0001).updateMask(cloudMask);
      const mndwi = scaled.expression('(G - S) / (G + S)', {
        G: scaled.select('B3'),
        S: scaled.select('B11')
      }).rename('mndwi');
      return scaled.addBands(mndwi);
    }
    function prepL2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));     // snow
      const refl = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B6']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).updateMask(mask);
      const mndwi = refl.expression('(G - S) / (G + S)', {
        G: refl.select('SR_B3'),
        S: refl.select('SR_B6')
      }).rename('mndwi');
      return refl.addBands(mndwi);
    }
    function compositeAndMeasure(col, bandNames) {
      const comp = col.median();
      const vis = comp.select(bandNames); // [blue, green, red]
      const mndwi = comp.select('mndwi');
      const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0);
      const visMean = vis.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).rename(['blue','green','red'].map(b=>b+'_mean'));
      const visAvg = visMean.expression('(b+g+r)/3', {
        b: visMean.select('blue_mean'),
        g: visMean.select('green_mean'),
        r: visMean.select('red_mean')
      }).rename('vismean').updateMask(waterMask);

      const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
      const cuStats = visAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducer,
        geometry: cuyuni,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const cfStats = visAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducer,
        geometry: confl,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      return {comp: comp, visAvg: visAvg, cuStats, cfStats};
    }

    // 3. Try Sentinel-2 exact day
    let used = null;
    let imgCount = 0;
    let cloudMean = null;

    let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterDate(dayStart, dayEnd)
      .filterBounds(aoi);
    imgCount = await s2.size().getInfo();

    let colPrepared = null;
    let bands = null;

    if (imgCount > 0) {
      const s2p = s2.map(prepS2);
      cloudMean = await ee.Number(s2.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')).getInfo();
      used = 'Sentinel-2 SR (same-day)';
      colPrepared = s2p;
      bands = ['B2','B3','B4'];
    } else {
      // Landsat 9 exact day
      let l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(dayStart, dayEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
      let l9Count = await l9.size().getInfo();
      if (l9Count > 0) {
        used = 'Landsat 9 L2 (same-day)';
        colPrepared = l9.map(prepL2);
        bands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4'];
        imgCount = l9Count;
      } else {
        // Landsat 8 exact day
        let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(dayStart, dayEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
        let l8Count = await l8.size().getInfo();
        if (l8Count > 0) {
          used = 'Landsat 8 L2 (same-day)';
          colPrepared = l8.map(prepL2);
          bands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4'];
          imgCount = l8Count;
        } else {
          // Widen window ±1 day: try S2 → L9 → L8
          let s2w = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED').filterDate(widenStart, widenEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
          let s2wCount = await s2w.size().getInfo();
          if (s2wCount > 0) {
            const s2wp = s2w.map(prepS2);
            cloudMean = await ee.Number(s2w.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')).getInfo();
            used = 'Sentinel-2 SR (±1 day)';
            colPrepared = s2wp;
            bands = ['B2','B3','B4'];
            imgCount = s2wCount;
          } else {
            let l9w = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(widenStart, widenEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
            let l9wCount = await l9w.size().getInfo();
            if (l9wCount > 0) {
              used = 'Landsat 9 L2 (±1 day)';
              colPrepared = l9w.map(prepL2);
              bands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4'];
              imgCount = l9wCount;
            } else {
              let l8w = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(widenStart, widenEnd).filterBounds(aoi);
              let l8wCount = await l8w.size().getInfo();
              if (l8wCount > 0) {
                used = 'Landsat 8 L2 (±1 day)';
                colPrepared = l8w.map(prepL2);
                bands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4'];
                imgCount = l8wCount;
              } else {
                console.log('No images found for the date/location (all fallbacks failed).');
                console.log('C1');
                return;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Processing
    const {cuStats, cfStats} = compositeAndMeasure(colPrepared, bands);

    const cuDict = await cuStats.getInfo();
    const cfDict = await cfStats.getInfo();

    const cuMean = cuDict ? cuDict['vismean_mean'] : null;
    const cuCount = cuDict ? cuDict['vismean_count'] : 0;
    const cfMean = cfDict ? cfDict['vismean_mean'] : null;
    const cfCount = cfDict ? cfDict['vismean_count'] : 0;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${used}`);
    console.log(`Images: ${imgCount}${cloudMean !== null ? `, Mean CLOUDY_PIXEL_%: ${cloudMean.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
    console.log(`Cuyuni water pixels: ${cuCount}`);
    console.log(`Confluence water pixels: ${cfCount}`);

    if ((cuCount === 0) || (cfCount === 0)) {
      console.log('No valid water pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (cuMean === null || cfMean === null || !isFinite(cuMean) || !isFinite(cfMean) ||
        cuMean < 0 || cfMean < 0 || cuMean > 1.2 || cfMean > 1.2) {
      console.log('Calculation failed or invalid reflectance values.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = cuMean - cfMean;
    console.log(`Cuyuni vis-mean refl: ${cuMean.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`Confluence vis-mean refl: ${cfMean.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`Difference (Cuyuni - Confluence): ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);
    const lighter = diff >= 0.01; // >=1% brighter considered lighter

    console.log(`Decision (Cuyuni lighter?): ${lighter ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(lighter ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
